post.text: Dave Bautista receives ceremonial belt whipping after earning his purple belt in Brazilian jiu-jitsu, honoring Gracie fighter tradition. https://t.co/EAFEokz3Hk

description.description: A series of frames showing former WWE wrestler Batista receiving his Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu belt in a gym setting. He is shirtless, displaying his iconic back tattoos, and wearing white gi pants. Several other practitioners in various colored gis (blue, black, and white) surround him on a blue mat with a gym logo. In the sequence, teammates playfully whip him with their belts as he walks across the mat, a traditional 'gauntlet' ceremony after a promotion. The gym wall features a 'Gracie Fighter Jiu-Jitsu' logo.
